# Translations for `tracy-business/j6` **1.2.2**

Copied byte for byte from [`../1.2.1/`](../1.2.1/README.md) (`MANIFEST.sha256` unchanged and still matching).

Why a copy is right: 1.2.2 is 1.2.1 plus the template patch for the Template Customization Question Readiness
check (interface text through `TPL_` keys, fonts with a Vietnamese subset) and a few database fixes: field
`module-810.3` (the "Hotline" label of the en version, Russian text before), the hidden secondary button link of
43 "Request a deck" modules, and post dates/order tie-broken. No field added or removed, field keys unchanged, so
translations joined by key keep their meaning (the vi translation of `module-810.3` already said "hotline").
